about.title: Road to Devcon India
about.lead: Devcon's impact started months before the event.
about.p1: Road to Devcon brought together communities, local organizations, and new audiences through programs designed to amplify grassroots efforts and create long-term impact.
about.p2: Together, our programs kept the community active, amplified local efforts and voices, and served as preparation for the culmination of the year: Devcon 8 India.

side_events.title: Side event calendars
side_events.lead: Hundreds of side events happened across Mumbai around Devcon. These calendars tracked them, each curated by a different community.
side_events.disclaimer: Listings were kept up to date by each calendar's curators during Devcon week; some may have since been taken down.

calendars.0xspace: Curated by 0xSpace. Side events grouped by day with RSVP links, and a form for hosts to submit their own.
calendars.ibw: The India Blockchain Week team's list of side events across IBW and Devcon week, with times and categories.
calendars.mira: Formerly Crypto Nomads. A directory with filters by event type and topic, plus RSVPs and add-to-calendar.
calendars.luma: A Luma calendar of events before, during and after Devcon. Subscribe to get every event in your own calendar.
calendars.build3: Curated by Bhavyam Arora. Side events with RSVP links, hosts and discount codes where available.
calendars.krew3: A Mumbai events directory with Devcon, IBW and side event filters, plus a venue finder for hosts.
